articles.title: Sliding down surfaces can make rainwater corrosive
articles.snippet: Water droplets can take on an electric charge when they slide across objects. Charged rain may start to eat through bridges, cars and more, new data show.
articles.summary: Water droplets can get an electric charge when they slide across objects. This charged rain may start to eat through cars and bridges.

articles.title: Let’s learn about hydrogels
articles.snippet: These polymer-based materials can sop up a lot of water — making them useful for a wide array of tasks.
articles.summary: Hydrogels are polymer-based materials that can absorb a large amount of water. This makes them useful for many different tasks.

articles.title: Newfound clouds of missing ‘ordinary’ matter sit outside galaxies
articles.snippet: Dark matter isn’t the universe’s only “missing” matter. Distant bursts of radio waves have now turned up vast, faint gas clouds surrounding galaxies.
